tally 908fac0b.summary: From an empty forms page, the author creates a form in a builder that works like a document. They add fields (text, required marks, logic, a grid, a rating) and keep it in Draft, ready to publish.

avoid: Questions can only be added one at a time with '+ New question' and cannot be reused across quizzes. That is weak for faculty checklists, which need item banks shared across scenarios (screens 6-8).
